# Trading Direkt 2026-09-29 | Konsensus på Wallstreet, Tobbe med TA och marknadsuppdatering

**Feed**: trading-direkt  
**Published**: 2026-09-29  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This was a market-update episode with no guest. The host covered big pharma deals: Novo Nordisk licensing Hengrui's oral GLP-1/GIP candidate, and AstraZeneca's $2bn investment in Summit Therapeutics. He also noted that US and Swedish banks agree almost unanimously on a bullish equity outlook, and asked whether that consensus is itself a risk. Tobbe Rosén's technical analysis stays positive on the long-term trend and expects a seasonal autumn low, but he flags warning signs: the US 10-year yield at about 5.25%, Brent near $100, a strong dollar and Middle East risk. His stock views were positive on Instalco, Paradox, Micron, Nordea, SanDisk, Sivers, Nanexa and Swedbank, and negative on BWX Technologies, Duni and Tesla.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 INSTAL — Instalco | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 65%

Strong uptrend and positive trampoline; the expected pullback is seen as a buying chance.

#### Reasoning

Tobbe: the price is 3% above the Bollinger band, so a short pullback is likely. Historically, 65-70% of similar cases were higher one month later. He says a pullback is probably worth buying and could lead to further gains.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the pullback turns into a trend break below key moving averages

> *"Så får vi en rekyl så är det med stor sannolikhet köpvärd."*

---

### 🟢 PDX — Paradox Interactive | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Above MA200 with a completed 1-2-3 trend reversal; good entry point.

#### Reasoning

Tobbe sees a confirmed 1-2-3 formation and a break above the MA200. He calls the current level a good place to take a position for an upmove and stays positive until new lower highs and lows appear.

#### Sell Triggers

- if new lower highs and lower lows form

> *"Så jag är positiv till Paradox"*

---

### 🟢 MU — Micron Technology | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Strong uptrend and a healthy pullback to 50%; buy on a positive candle.

#### Reasoning

Micron had a near-parabolic rise followed by a healthy pullback to the 50% level. Buyers pushed it above resistance and it is now retesting that level. Tobbe calls it buyable on a positive candlestick at the breakout level or the rising support line.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the breakout level and rising support line fail

> *"Så här tycker jag att den är köpvärd när vi väl får en positiv candlestick formation."*

---

### 🟢 NDA-SE — Nordea | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Tobbe is positive and expects further gains; a dip to 195-200 is a good entry.

#### Reasoning

This is a positive continuation pattern, although the uptrend is sluggish and overlapping. Tobbe sees a much higher chance of gains than of a reversal. A deeper pullback to the 195-200 zone would be a good entry.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the 195-200 support fails

> *"Nordea är jag också positiv till. Här tror jag på fortsatta uppgångar."*

---

### 🟢 SNDK — SanDisk | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Rising trend above the standard line after a deep pullback; main scenario is further upside.

#### Reasoning

SanDisk is above the standard line and the medium-term moving averages. Tobbe's main scenario is a continued rise. A break below about $1500 that is not quickly regained would open a fall to about $1400 or the MA200.

#### Sell Triggers

- if price breaks below $1500 and doesn't quickly recover

> *"mitt huvudspår är att priset ska dra vidare uppåt från den här nivån"*

---

### 🟢 SIVE — Sivers Semiconductor | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Pullback stopped at a rising MA200 with a new higher low; Tobbe is weakly positive.

#### Reasoning

After a new higher high, the pullback formed a higher low at the rising MA200. Tobbe sees good short-term conditions for further gains. A break of 27 SEK, and especially 22 SEK, would mean a much bigger fall.

#### Sell Triggers

- if 27 SEK breaks
- if 22 SEK breaks

> *"Jag är svagt positiv till aktien"*

---

### 🟠 NANEXA — Nanexa | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 55%

Rose 150% on news; Tobbe is positive but advises waiting for a pullback to Fib 50 or the standard line.

#### Reasoning

The 150% jump shows strength, but late buyers risk selling pressure if the price falls back. Tobbe would enter where buyers return near Fib 50 or the standard line, for a better risk/reward. A break of Fib 62 risks a fall back to fill the gap.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Fib 62 breaks
- if the standard line fails

> *"Så jag är positiv till aktien, definitivt. Men svårt och knepigt när man ska ta position."*

---

### 🟡 SWED-A — Swedbank | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Tobbe is positive, but it is short-term overbought (RSI 72) with pullback risk; don't chase.

#### Reasoning

The stock rose strongly over three months and is above the Bollinger band. Historically it has often been lower a week later in this setup. Longer-term odds of a rise are good, but chasing at this level is tricky.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the pullback becomes a trend break

> *"Swedbank är jag också positiv till. Här är det nog dock dags för en rekyl."*

---

### 🟠 GENI — Generic Sweden | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Tight contraction; a positive stochastic MACD cross would be a buy signal.

#### Reasoning

The moving averages have converged in a low-volatility squeeze and a powerful move is likely once it breaks out. The direction is unconfirmed; entering on a turtle-soup setup allows a tighter stop.

#### Sell Triggers

- if it breaks down out of the contraction

> *"Så intressant att hålla koll på generic tycker jag"*

---

### 🟠 GPG — Genova | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Testing the MA200 with very low volatility; wait and see with a faintly positive undertone.

#### Reasoning

Low volatility usually precedes a larger move. Some signs point up, but the falling triangle carries downside risk.

#### Sell Triggers

- if it breaks down from the falling triangle

> *"Så avvaktande med en liten, liten, liten trendmässigt svagt positiv underton."*

---

### ⛔ BWXT — BWX Technologies | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Broke Fib 62 support; oversold, with risk of a fall to $100 and then $85.

#### Reasoning

The stock set a lower high, failed at Fib 50 and has now broken Fib 62 without recovering. The hope rests on November 2024 support, but Tobbe sees no sign of buyers there. He sees a large risk of a fall to $85.

> *"då tror jag att det är ganska så stor risk för att vi kommer få se en nedgång ner mot typ 85 dollars nivån"*

---

### ⛔ DUNI — Duni | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 55%

Lowest level since 2022 with no sign of buyers; a double bottom is not yet confirmed.

#### Reasoning

Tobbe wants positive candles, a break of the last short-term high and higher lows before turning positive. A confirmed double bottom would target nearly 90 SEK. The late-October report may change the picture.

#### Sell Triggers

- if it breaks above the neckline and confirms the double bottom (turns positive)
- if the Q3 report surprises positively

> *"Och så länge vi inte ser det så ser jag inte att köparna är på väg tillbaka."*

---

### ⛔ TSLA — Tesla | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Tobbe is weakly negative after it broke the standard line; risk of a fall to $340.

#### Reasoning

Unless the standard line is quickly regained, Tobbe expects a fall first to about $340 and possibly lower.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the standard line is quickly regained (invalidates the bearish view)

> *"Så jag är lite svagt. negativt till Tesla så som det ser ut just nu"*

---

### 🟢 NORION — Norion Bank | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Cited analyst view: SEB upgraded it to buy from hold, with the target price raised to 81 from 59 SEK.

#### Reasoning

This is the analyst's view (SEB), not the host's. The target of 81 SEK is about 17% above the current 69 SEK.

#### Sell Triggers

- if SEB downgrades

> *"har Nourion Bank blivit höjd till köp från behåll hos SEB"*

---

### 🟡 BILL — Billerud | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Cited analyst view: Jefferies cut it to hold from buy but raised the target price to 90 SEK.

#### Reasoning

This is the analyst's view (Jefferies). The target of 90 SEK is only moderately above the current 82 SEK, hence hold.

> *"Jeffries har sänkt sin rekommendation för Billerud tillbehåll från köp"*

---

### 🟡 FABG — Fabege | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Cited analyst view: ABG raised it to hold from sell, with the target price cut to 70 SEK.

#### Reasoning

This is the analyst's view (ABG Sundal Collier). The target of 70 SEK is close to the current 67 SEK.

> *"Fabege har fått sin rekommendation höjd till behåll från sälj hos ABG Sundahl Collier"*
